gates.label: Sign-in (Free ok)
gates.note: Any signed-in user. Free is enough. Not a separate plan named Member.

gates.label: Buy separately
gates.note: Pro alone does not unlock. Needs product purchase entitlement.

notes.title: member ≠ a plan
notes.body: In registry JSON, access:"member" means sign-in required. Free accounts can download those items. It is not a paid plan name.

notes.title: Websites = buy separately
notes.body: Paid websites need a product entitlement. Pro alone does not unlock them. Grant/revoke from a user detail page.

notes.title: CLI / MCP
notes.body: Site Installation panels respect access. Public /r JSON files are still fetchable - gating is mainly website UI + Pro APIs.

notes.title: Pro packages + popups
notes.body: Pro-only items (e.g. popups from lib/popups-nav.ts) are listed here with access:"pro". Install/source still comes from /api/pro/components (private GitHub Pro registry) — this index does not fetch that repo at build time.

notes.title: Backgrounds / cursors downloads
notes.body: Catalog pages may wrap downloads in AccessGate (sign-in) even when browsing is open.

notes.title: Keep this page fresh
notes.body: After changing registry access, popups-nav, or templates-catalog prices, run npm run registry:build (or npm run access:index).
